name: MAPK / AP-1 output
note: the transcriptional readout of RAS-RAF-MEK-ERK signalling

name: Proliferation / cell cycle
note: MYC and the E2F programme that drives S-phase entry

name: p53 / DNA damage
note: rises when DNA is damaged or replication stalls

name: Stress / unfolded protein
note: heat shock, oxidative and ER stress; also rises as cells die

name: Hypoxia / metabolism
note: oxygen sensing, lipid and sterol synthesis

name: PI3K / AKT output
note: FOXO is held inactive by AKT, so it rises when the pathway is blocked

name: Chromatin / general
note: broad transcriptional machinery rather than one pathway

name: Developmental / lineage
note: identity programmes; usually stable within a cell line
